payload.friendly_name: Operating-model templates and a Role kind
payload.purpose_context: About half of the EU SCC technical-and-organisational-measure headings describe an operating model (governance, accountability, incident handling, supplier management). DocKitty can stub a page today but gives no body template and has no kind for an accountable role. This mission adds an opt-in operating-model section preset, structure-and-prompt templates in the stub tools, and a Role kind, so consumers can document their operating model and classify it against the measures catalog.
payload.purpose_tldr: Give teams ready page templates for documenting how their organisation runs, plus a Role page kind for accountable functions.

payload.question: Should Role be a new canonical kind, or a sub-use of Persona?

options: Add Runbook as a new kind
payload.question: Runbook is a type, not a kind. Which kind do the incident and continuity templates carry?
Which fields does the validator require on a Role page?

payload.final_answer: New Role kind, recorded in ADR-0085. Decider: operator (verbatim "agreed" at 2026-11-23T21:09:45Z in the dispatcher session, to the runner's recommendation of a new kind; relayed by the dispatcher, ledger R80; verified against the dispatcher transcript).

A: the Incident and breach response and Business continuity templates use kind How-To and are placed under operations/runbooks/, so type Runbook is derived. Role is the only vocabulary change. Decider: operator (verbatim "as recommended", dispatcher session, ledger R81, to the dispatcher prompt "#402: Q2 and Q3. I recommend A for both"; relayed by the dispatcher; checked against the dispatcher transcript).

A: a kind Role page requires role (a non-empty string) and responsibilities (a non-empty list of non-empty strings); goals stays optional. Decider: operator (verbatim "as recommended", dispatcher session, ledger R81, to the dispatcher prompt "#402: Q2 and Q3. I recommend A for both"; relayed by the dispatcher; checked against the dispatcher transcript).
